other_conditions: Must be a regular faculty member of a college/university/higher educational institution in India
Must have at least five years of full‑time teaching experience at the undergraduate and/or postgraduate level

Self‑nomination is not allowed; nominations must be made by the Vice‑Chancellor/Director/Principal of the institution, a colleague or former faculty member of the same institution, former Vice‑Chancellor/Director/Principal (if currently teaching full‑time), or search committee members
Vice‑Chancellor/Director/Principal (regular or officiating) are not eligible to apply
benefits_summary: A medal, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹ 50,000 are awarded to each recipient.
